column3: NASB renders “the one who had done this” as “the woman who had done this.”
“Has saved you” is rendered “has made you well,” and “be healthy” is “be healed.”
NASB renders “ruler of the synagogue” as “synagogue official.”
NASB renders the critical text’s word (ignoring or overhearing) as “overhearing” and adds “any longer.” It has no “immediately,” like the critical text.
NASB renders “follow with Him” as “accompany Him.”
NASB adds “the room” and has no “lying,” like the critical text; “those with Him” is “His own companions.”
NASB puts the translation in parentheses and spells “Talitha kum.”
NASB renders “amazed with great amazement” as “completely astounded.”
